contradictions.what: Rep said they couldn't show 'nothing, really' and 'a clean one', then admitted dancing around PayPal/Venmo and having no Venmo answer.
'Clean one' conflicts with an unfulfilled saved-cards reference request and an unresolved 'we'll find out' at kickoff.
Daniel is presented as decider, yet rep says their engineer effectively sold the deal; the prototype shifted Daniel from 'if'.
Rep says customer 'decided it was a risk they'd take' though PayPal/Venmo worry drove the questions and Venmo was never answered.
CFO's question about sitter payment timing and the stalled faster-pay roadmap item hint finance cared about pay speed, while Daniel framed finance as rubber-stamp.

dodges.what: Answered 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one.' then admitted PayPal/Venmo evasion and unfulfilled saved-card reference at T18-T20 after being prompted.
